claim_boundary: Rank-2 row-major f32 GEMM on one x86-64 AVX2/FMA host. Static direct, M/N/K fringe adapt, and one-binary dynamic-shape execution are implemented for the fixed BLIS Haswell 6x16 microkernel. Dynamic multi-shape speedups use a scalar-loop fallback; arbitrary layouts, additional dtypes/contracts, optimized dynamic baselines, and cross-host statistics remain outside this experiment.
